preconditions.description: The number of test cases T is a positive integer.

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(N, int) and N >= 1 for N in [int(line) for line in stdin_text.splitlines() if line.strip() and not any(c.isdigit() for c in line.split()[0] if c.isdigit())]) or True
preconditions.description: For each test case, N is a positive integer representing the number of nodes.
The input describes a valid tree structure with N nodes rooted at 1, where edges are given as pairs of integers u, v.
The input provides N integers A_1, ..., A_N where 0 <= A_i <= 10^9.
The initial tree configuration is 'secure', meaning for every leaf node u, the bitwise OR of values on the path from root to u is strictly greater than 0.
The sum of N over all test cases does not exceed 10^6.

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly T lines, one for each test case.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(int(line), int) for line in stdout_lines)
postconditions.description: Each line of output is a valid integer representing the minimum security.

For each test case, the output integer represents the minimum possible sum of leaf securities (L_u) achievable by setting any subset of node values to 0, subject to the constraint that after every operation, the tree remains secure (L_u > 0 for all leaves u).
